work.text: Sekka’s selections hew closely to precedents from the Rinpa style originated by painter Tawaraya Sōtatsu (c. 1570–c. 1640) and calligrapher Hon’ami Kōetsu (1558–1637).

moment.text: This has curved rocks in copper reds and stone blues and greens arising out of a boiling sea of gold and cream. The foam is done in leaping masses of solid white.
moment.lead: Fenollosa on Kōrin's great wave screen, now in Boston:

source.author: Ernest F. Fenollosa
source.title: Epochs of Chinese & Japanese Art, vol. 2

moment.text: Sometime in the early 18th century, Kōrin painted a notable copy of Tawaraya Sōtatsu's work, Waves at Matsushima.

matters.text: Many of the scenes have a long history in Japan, originating in the 900s or 1000s and having been interpreted by all manner of artists since that time.
